content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

General rule: aim for 1.6–2.2 grams per kg of body weight daily. That covers muscle growth for most lifters—more than that doesn't add much benefit, and less starts to limit your gains.

What matters most is hitting that target consistently, eating enough total calories to support growth, and training hard (which you're doing for that 100 kg bench in three months 💪). Spread it across your meals and hit your workouts.
